text:
Sasha L: Heads up — we're getting repeated duplicate spans in traces and a big surge in the OTLP exporter queue from the eu-west GPU fleet after the infra deploy last night. Prom alert otlp_exporter_queue_length has been noisy. Anyone else seeing this?
Eric P: Yup, noticed it ~03:30 UTC. Inference tail latency also spiked and the GPU job queue jumped. Grafana panels: <https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/d/abcd/inference-overview|inference overview> and <https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/d/efgh/otlp-exporter|otlp exporter>.
Tom M: Logs from the sidecar show repeated gRPC RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and UNAVAILABLE errors when sending to the collector, followed by huge retry/backoff windows. Looks like exporter backpressure is building up in the SDK.
Sasha L: deploy-bot rolled out sidecar v0.60 to eu-west at 03:12 UTC yesterday. Could be related. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Rolled out telemetry-sidecar:v0.60 to nodes: eu-west-gpu-{pool-a,pool-b} @ 2024-10-18T03:12:07Z
Kai Y: Don't rush a full rollback. We should triage config first — v0.60 changed some default batching and queue settings. If the collector is temporarily under-provisioned exporters will pile up and create duplicate spans when retries succeed later.
Ajay R: Confirmed — collector pods autoscaled down during the window (HPA hit min replicas) while exporter queue climbed. When collector pods came back we saw a flood of previously buffered spans which looks like duplication in traces and explodes our OTLP ingestion rate.
Tom M: Proposed short mitigation: reduce SDK max_queue_size and decrease batch_max_export_size so retries are smaller, and increase exporter timeout to avoid aggressive retries. Also throttle send concurrency in the collector. Example SDK env tweak:
```
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=https://otlp-collector.internal:4317
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_PROTOCOL=grpc
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_TIMEOUT=30000  # 30s
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_HEADERS=api-key=REDACTED
OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE=2000
OTEL_BSP_MAX_EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE=256
OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY_MILLIS=2000
```
Sasha L: Ok makes sense. Can someone try a config change on a single deployment / canary? We should also add a panel for exporter_queue_len and exporter_retry_backoff to the infra dashboard.
Eric P: I'll spin up a canary with the reduced queue and batch size on one sidecar replica set in eu-west and monitor. Will update the grafana link.
Ajay R: Also recommend changing the Prom alert to 5m sustained at high severity and a separate 1m warning level so on-call doesn't get paged for short flashbacks. Right now it fires on 30s and that's noisier than useful.
Kai Y: Filed infra ticket INFRA-2891 to track root cause, config canary, and alert tuning. Action items in the ticket: 1) canary SDK config change, 2) collector horizontal target increase during rollout windows, 3) add exporter queue/backpressure metrics to SLO dashboard, 4) adjust Prom alert windows.
Tom M: One more note — we should tag spans with service.region and node.pool to help correlate which nodes produce buffered spans. Add attribute in runtime instrumentation: resource detectors should include "redwood.region" and "redwood.node_pool".
Sasha L: Great. Thanks all. Eric, please paste canary results here once you have them. If the config tweak fixes the flood we can roll a non-breaking tweak to other regions before considering a rollback. :thumbsup:
